environment.description: Same Rails application deployed in a Kubernetes pod with the following runtime constraints: container rootfs mounted read-only via securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with no writable volumes (no tmpfs, no emptyDir, no PVC mounts). The pod spec includes a NetworkPolicy with egress rules restricting outbound connections exclusively to the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and a single external CIDR block 203.0.113.0/24 (partner API range). Additionally, the node's iptables DNAT rules for the instance metadata service are stripped via a DaemonSet that runs `iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -d 169.254.169.254 -j DNAT` on node boot, and the EKS cluster has the IMDSv2 hop limit set to 1 (preventing containerized workloads from reaching IMDS through the extra network hop).

config.volumes: none (no tmpfs, no emptyDir, no PVC)
config.network_policy: egress allowed only to kube-dns:53/UDP and 203.0.113.0/24
config.imds_protection: IMDSv2 hop limit 1 + iptables DNAT rule stripped on node
config.container_security_context: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true
